cleavage agent: Proteins were digested with trypsin according to a standard operating procedure.
enrichment method: we next performed coimmunoprecipitation assays of testosterone and 17β-estradiol with P. aeruginosa lysates combined with mass spectrometry (MS) analysis.
fragmentation method: Tandem MS was performed by applying high-energy collisional dissociation.
labeling: Protein identification was based on at least two matching peptides of 95% confidence per protein.
